role: independent reviewer of root compaction change; author of narrowly approved HTTP fallback fix

findings.original: Only compact URL was requested; a valid V14 expanded index could not recover a missing compact file. Reproduced against actual V14 expanded index.
findings.resolution: Typed HTTP request error; fallback only on HTTP 404 or 410; validated expanded payload. All other errors fail closed.

checks: Build encoder preserves all existing metadata fields; step object keys removed only after metadata() has reduced each step to its ID. Runtime decoder restores exact descriptors and step objects. Build aborts if JSON round-trip differs.

All descriptor paths derive from bounded safe IDs and full hexadecimal digest; expanded loader retains exact path/size/hash validation. Response limit, no redirects, immutable payload checksum, retry, deduplication and protected no-store branches unchanged.
New codec is included in source manifest inputs and the app module bundle; standalone offline preload embeds its self-contained function without ES modules or fetch.
bootstrap.js and offline-runtime.js are byte-identical to V14. Existing HTML shell plus deferred bootstrap preserves home-first rendering; no claim of a newly added V15 boot mechanism.

File mode still preloads only expanded catalogue metadata, then loads individual course/resource/auxiliary classic scripts. Course payload generation is unchanged from V14; no teaching-body reduction is introduced by index compaction.
Expanded data/lazy/index.json remains generated for compatibility and diagnostics; compact version is also in generated output manifest.

executedTests.details: normal compact/expanded; 404/410 fallback; 401/403/429/500/503 fail; network and forged status fail; malformed JSON/digest/catalogue/guided IDs and oversized response fail; unsafe fallback descriptor fail; retry after both missing; file missing/preloaded modes perform no fetch.
